I just uploaded an export of my chats from another AI assistant to my workspace at \"%1$s\". Please read it, extract durable facts about me – interests, preferences, recurring topics, ongoing projects – and remember them via your memory tooling. Skip anything ephemeral or sensitive. Confirm what you stored.

You are helping me migrate context from one AI assistant to another. Your job is to compile, from our past conversations, a portable memory snapshot of what you reliably know about me. The output is going verbatim into a new AI\'s memory, so quality matters more than completeness. OUTPUT RULES: Output a single Markdown block using the section headers below. Omit any section that you have nothing solid for – do not invent placeholders. - Refer to me in the third person (\"the user\", \"they\") inside each bullet. Do not use first-person pronouns referring to yourself. - One factual sentence per bullet. No transitions, no narrative, no caveats outside the bullet itself. - Mark anything that you are uncertain about with \"(inferred)\" at the end of the bullet. - Skip one-off statements unless they were clearly important. Prefer facts reinforced across multiple conversations. - Skip outdated facts older than ~3 months unless they are identity-level (name, location, profession). - Skip sensitive information (health conditions, financial details, relationship problems, mental health) unless I explicitly asked you to remember it. - Hard cap: 2,000 words. Density beats coverage. SECTIONS ## Identity Name, pronouns, age range, current city/country, time zone, languages spoken. ## Profession and work role, company or self-employed, industry, team or function, key responsibilities. Tech stack and tools used daily if known. ## Communication preferences Tone that they want (casual/formal, blunt/warm). Preferred response length (short/medium/long).
